34671.source: Last time you tried out the frethand mutes in this song{C} it sounded like you could use a little practice. No problem! Give Gone Wailin' a shot to prep. It'll make working on frethand mutes fun{C} and after you'll be ready to nail them in this song.
34671.before: 上次尝试这首歌曲中的左手闷音时{C}听起来你需要多练习一下。没问题！试试 Gone Wailin' 来热身。这会让练习左手闷音变得有趣{C}，之后你就能在这首歌曲中完美演奏它们了。
